prompts.title: The Animated Captain
prompts.prompt:
Create a high-quality 3D animated portrait of a person with natural-length hair and large, expressive brown eyes. The subject has a serious, determined, and confident expression. They are wearing an incredibly detailed Argentina national football team jersey featuring classic white and light blue vertical stripes, a golden AFA crest on the left chest, a central Sun of May emblem, and black trim on the collar and sleeves. The subject is holding a modern, colorful World Cup-style soccer ball tucked confidently under their right arm.
The camera angle is eye-level, capturing a medium close-up portrait from the waist up in a perfectly symmetrical, centered composition. The background features a shallow depth of field with beautiful bokeh, revealing a crowded, massive football stadium filled with out-of-focus cheering fans wearing Argentina colors. Bright stadium floodlights shine in the distance against a vibrant twilight sky blending from sunset yellow to dusk blue.
Cinematic golden-hour lighting with a soft rim light illuminating the edges of the subject's hair. Rendered in Unreal Engine 5, Octane Render style, stylized 3D animation, Pixar or Valorant aesthetic, 8K resolution, hyper-detailed textures, and incredibly sharp focus on the main subject.
Aspect ratio: 4:5.

prompts.title: Club Football Splash
prompts.prompt:
Use the uploaded image strictly ONLY for face matching and identity reference.
Create an ultra-realistic, cinematic 8K sports poster featuring a confident football player representing [TEAM_NAME]. The subject stands in a strong, confident pose, centered in the frame, making direct eye contact with the camera. He wears premium team apparel inspired by [TEAM_NAME], crest, and signature design elements.
Dynamic Theme Adaptation:
Replace all colors with the official colors of [TEAM_NAME].
Replace background flag, symbols, paint splashes, and visual effects with elements representing [TEAM_NAME].
Replace the crest, jersey details, typography accents, and football graphics with [TEAM_NAME] branding.
Stadium lighting, crowd atmosphere, and visual energy should match the identity and spirit of [TEAM_NAME].
Composition: Mid-thigh-up portrait, centered in the frame. Captured from an eye-level camera angle, with the subject fully visible and no head cropping.
Pose & Expression:
The subject stands strong upright posture, shoulders squared. Right arm is bent naturally at the elbow, securing a soccer ball against his hip, while the left arm hangs relaxed by his side. Calm, determined, championship-winning expression. Direct eye contact conveying confidence, pride, and leadership(no smile).
Outfit:
Premium [TEAM_NAME] Themed Matching Jersey. Official team crest on the chest, sponsor-free design, realistic fabric textures, embroidered details, and authentic sportswear styling.
Background:
Massive distressed typography displaying "[TEAM_NAME]" across the upper background. Behind the subject, a large dynamic flag representing [TEAM_NAME] emerges through explosive paint splashes, smoke effects, energy streaks, and flying particles. A packed stadium with dramatic floodlights fills the lower background.
Effects:
High-energy sports-poster aesthetic, paint splatter textures, dynamic brush strokes, glowing stadium lights, cinematic smoke, floating particles, dramatic contrast, premium advertising campaign quality.
Typography:
Large distressed "[TEAM_NAME]" title at the top.
Lighting:
Dramatic stadium floodlights, cinematic rim lighting, volumetric atmosphere, warm highlights, deep shadows, high contrast sports-advertisement lighting.
Technical Details:
Ultra-realistic, hyper-detailed skin texture, sharp facial features, HDR, professional sports campaign photography, 85mm lens, shallow depth of field, cinematic color grading, poster-quality composition, premium FIFA-style promotional artwork, 8K resolution.
Aspect ratio 4:5.

prompts.title: Elite Stat Card
prompts.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the primary identity source. The generated portrait must match the same person exactly, preserving precise facial structure, head shape, jawline, cheekbones, eyes, nose, lips, hairstyle, glasses style, skin tone, and overall proportions. Maintain true identity fidelity and strong facial recognition accuracy. Do not beautify, stylize, or alter facial features. Preserve natural asymmetry, skin texture, and authentic likeness.
Create a highly stylized, ultra-detailed futuristic e-sports gaming profile card or “leader card” with a legendary-tier competitive aesthetic. The composition is in vertical 4:5 aspect ratio, centered, symmetrical, and designed like a premium digital character card from a modern competitive video game.
Central Portrait & Pose

The subject is centered in the frame, shown from mid-torso upward, facing forward with direct eye contact. He is making a confident “shushing” gesture, holding his right index finger vertically against his lips, conveying a calm, dominant, and quietly confident persona. His posture is upright and composed, with relaxed shoulders and balanced framing.
He is wearing a professional e-sports athletic jersey in black and electric blue, featuring realistic fabric texture, subtle stitching, breathable mesh panels, and modern competitive gaming uniform styling.
Background & Aura

Behind the subject’s head is a glowing circular digital halo or energy portal in bright neon blue, perfectly centered and symmetrical. The halo emits soft radial light rays and contains subtle sci-fi elements such as faint hexagonal grid patterns, floating digital particles, glowing data fragments, and atmospheric sparkles. The background fades into a deep dark blue and black gradient with depth, cinematic glow, and futuristic ambiance.
Card Frame & Border Design

The entire portrait is enclosed within a thick, metallic, futuristic frame with layered dimensional structure. The frame is made of brushed silver metal with illuminated neon accents in electric blue and subtle gold/yellow highlights. The corners are angular, geometric, and industrial, with glowing seams, reflective metallic edges, and sci-fi panel detailing. Soft light reflections and glow effects enhance the premium, legendary card appearance.
Typography & Branding

At the top center of the card, display the name:
“JACK XP”
in large, bold, futuristic sans-serif typography, white with bright blue neon glow, subtle metallic reflections, and soft bloom lighting.
Directly below it, display the title:
“LEADER”
in smaller, clean teal or cyan futuristic font with subtle glow.
On the subject’s chest area, overlay a shield-shaped crest logo with metallic gold and blue textures. The crest reads:
JACK XP

LEADER

ARMY
with layered typography, glowing accents, beveled metallic edges, and premium emblem styling.
Gaming Statistics Panel

At the bottom of the card, include a sleek futuristic stats panel with glowing borders and dark metallic background. Display the following performance metrics in high-contrast, bold, futuristic font:
HEADSHOT RATE: 97%

K/D RATIO: 5.2

WIN RATE: 93%
The numbers should be large, bright, and glowing in electric blue, with smaller white labels above them.
Lighting & Rendering Style

Use cinematic studio lighting combined with futuristic neon rim lighting. The face must remain clearly visible with realistic skin tone and proper exposure. Add soft blue rim light around the edges of the subject to integrate him naturally into the sci-fi environment. Include subtle glow bloom, volumetric light, and atmospheric depth.
Color Palette

Dominant colors: electric blue, deep navy blue, black, metallic silver

Accent colors: neon cyan, subtle gold/yellow highlights

Maintain high contrast, rich saturation, and premium digital finish.
Rendering Quality

Ultra-realistic, hyper-detailed, 8K resolution, professional e-sports character card, sharp focus, clean edges, cinematic contrast, advanced glow effects, realistic materials, and premium competitive gaming aesthetic.
